## Description

Support tool and SLA targets (first response < 4 business hours), severity definitions, on-call rota (including a backup person), runbooks (incident, restore, key rotation, patient mismatch), support metrics.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** SLA and severity matrix published to customers.
- [ ] **AC2.** Support response time is measured; pilot month shows ≥ 95 % within target.
- [ ] **AC3.** A second person can execute the restore runbook (verified once).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
